peft_classifier_out_w = peft_model.base_model.model.classifier.out_proj.weight

adapter_out_w = adapter_state["base_model.model.classifier.out_proj.weight"]

print(f"Peft classifier.out_proj.weight shape: {peft_classifier_out_w.shape}")
print(f"Adapter classifier.dense.weight shape: {adapter_dense_w.shape}")
print(f"Adapter classifier.out_proj.weight shape: {adapter_out_w.shape}")

dense_equal = t.allclose(peft_classifier_dense_w, adapter_dense_w)
out_equal = t.allclose(peft_classifier_out_w, adapter_out_w)
print(f"Trained head dense weights match adapter: {dense_equal}")
print(f"Trained head out_proj weights match adapter: {out_equal}")

print("=== Merging and unloading ===")
merged = peft_model.merge_and_unload()
print(f"Merged model classifier weight shape: {merged.classifier.weight.shape}")

print("=== Saving merged model and tokenizer ===")
merged.save_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
tok.save_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
print("Merged model saved to /app/merged_model")

print("=== DONE Phase 2 ===")

import torch
import json
import numpy as np
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# Load from /app/merged_model (fresh from_pretrained)
print("=== Loading merged model from /app/merged_model ===")
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
model.eval()

# Load id2label from config
with open("/app/merged_model/config.json") as f:
    config = json.load(f)
id2label = config["id2label"]
print(f"id2label: {id2label}")

samples = [
    "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?",
    "Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?",
    "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
    "Ciao, come stai oggi?",
    "Olá, como você está?",
    "Привет, как дела?",
    "こんにちは、お元気ですか？",
    "你好，你好吗？",
    "مرحبا، كيف حالك؟",
    "Hello, how are you?",
]

results = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for i, text in enumerate(samples):
        inputs = tok(text, return_tensors="pt", padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=512)
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        logits = outputs.logits[0]
        pid = int(logits.argmax().item())
        # softmax
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        conf = float(probs[pid].item())
        conf_rounded = round(conf, 6)
        lang_name = id2label.get(str(pid), f"unknown({pid})")
        print(f"Sample {i+1}: '{text[:50]}...' -> class={pid} ({lang_name}), conf={conf_rounded}")
        results.append({
            "text": text,
            "predicted_class_id": pid,
            "confidence": conf_rounded
        })

# Write results
with open("/app/detection_results.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
